description: Negative rules or exemptions cannot be derived from search failures. Explicit legal absence attestation is mandatory to claim RULE_ABSENCE_VERIFIED.

schema.evidenceRefs: array of strings (minimum 1 specific clause/section proof)

prohibitedBehaviors: Search returned 0 results treated as RULE_ABSENCE_VERIFIED
Empty rules array treated as absence of restrictions
enforcementOutcome: Falsified or incomplete absence attestation drops family resolution strictly to RULE_UNRESOLVED, triggering PARTIAL_SOURCE_PACKAGE and preventing false eligibility.
